lint.why: No VM tests. Evaluates the whole flake, checks every flake check is in exactly one shard, builds the host's closure and the quick checks, then formats and lints. Its cache holds the host's closure, about 2 GB.

alerting.why: alerting-a, the first half of the alerting test (#182), waits out alert durations and is expected to take about 18 minutes. dns (#164) is expected to take its second build slot, beside short VM tests, rather than join system, which already holds alerting-b (Nix decides the start order, not this file). dns's nuc has four cores, so it competes for the runner's CPUs with alerting-a; alerting-a's timings leave room for that (#182). The other half, alerting-b, is in system, so the two halves run side by side.

services.why: The services the host runs: observability (about 12 minutes), Docker and the Compose stacks (the two largest VMs, 4 GB and 3 GB) and the announcements to players.

system.why: How the host is reached, deployed and booted: tailscale, comin, notify and disk-tpm, about 15 minutes one after another, expected in one build slot while alerting-b, the second half of the alerting test (#182, expected about 18 minutes), holds the other. Nix decides the start order, not this file.
